gloss: a word, a call; a brief mention

definitions.gloss: a word, a call, a single utterance
definitions.explanation: A single word or brief verbal communication.

definitions.gloss: a quick word, a brief mention
definitions.explanation: Giving a quick heads-up or brief notification to someone.

examples.japanese: 「⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧ぞ」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{一声|ひとこえ}⟦かけた→かける：00854_kakeru⟧。

examples.english: I woke up to the call of a bird.

examples.japanese: ⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{鶴|つる}→鶴：04359_tsuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{一声|ひとこえ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{決|き}まった→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧。
examples.english: It was decided by the president's final word.

examples.japanese: ⟦{出|で}かける→出かける：00833_dekakeru⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{一声|ひとこえ}⟦かけて→かける：00854_kakeru⟧⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
examples.english: Give me a shout before you leave.

examples.japanese: ⟦{何|なに}か→何か：03873_nanika⟧⟦あったら→ある：00006_aru⟧{一声|ひとこえ}⟦かけて→かける：00854_kakeru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please give me a quick word if anything happens.

examples.japanese: ⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{一声|ひとこえ}⟦かけて→かける：00854_kakeru⟧⟦くれれば→くれる：00724_kureru⟧⟦よかった→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧。
examples.english: You should have given me a heads-up first.

notes:
COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {一声|ひとこえ}かける: to give someone a quick word or heads-up, especially before doing something (⟦{出|で}かける→出かける：00833_dekakeru⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{一声|ひとこえ}かけて)
- ⟦{鶴|つる}→鶴：04359_tsuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{一声|ひとこえ}: literally "a crane's call"; a word from someone in authority that settles a matter at once
- {第一声|だいいっせい}: the first words someone says (after arriving, on taking office)
